documents_found.title: Hyderabad Ward-Wise Register No.5 (Ward No.1 to Ward No.25, GHMC) - Kitabul Aukaf Register
documents_found.coverage: Hyderabad GHMC, Wards 1-25 (Kabadiguda, Adikmet, Musheerabad, Hyderguda, Begumpet, Amberpet, Lingampally, Nampally, Khairtabad, etc.) - Hyderabad district
documents_found.notes: Official Telangana State Waqf Board scanned register, 398 pages, text-layer extractable via PDF parsing (pypdf). Contains individual property-level records with wakif name, class of wakf, property description, village/ward, boundaries (N/E/S/W), valuation, survey/municipal number, and registration/gazette history. Columns are jumbled by page-pair layout (data page + continuation page) but content is legible and was manually reconstructed for ~20 records here; document contains many hundreds more records not yet fully parsed.
